skills.title: Way isdejiyaan marka lala hadlo ama kor loo qaado
skills.sourceTitle: Calms down when spoken to or picked up

skills.title: Wajigaaga ayay eegaan
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at your face

skills.title: Waxay u muuqataa mid ku faraxsan inay ku aragto markaad iyada u soo socoto
skills.sourceTitle: Seems happy to see you when you walk up to her

skills.title: Way dhoola cadeeysaa markaad la hadasho ama aad u dhoola cadayso
skills.sourceTitle: Smiles when you talk to or smile at her

skills.title: Waxay sameeyaan dhawaaqyo aan oohin ahayn
skills.sourceTitle: Makes sounds other than crying

skills.title: Waxay ku falceliyaan dhawaaqyo cod dheer ah
skills.sourceTitle: Reacts to loud sounds

skills.title: Waxay ku daawanayan markaad dhaqaaqeyso
skills.sourceTitle: Watches you as you move

skills.title: Waxay eegaan alaab-alaabayda dhowr ilbiriqsi
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at a toy for several seconds

skills.title: Madaxa ayay kor u qaadaan markay caloosha u jiifaan
skills.sourceTitle: Holds head up when on tummy

skills.title: Waxay dhaqdhaqaajiyan labada gacmood iyo labada lugood
skills.sourceTitle: Moves both arms and both legs

skills.title: Gacmaha ayay si kooban u furaan
skills.sourceTitle: Opens hands briefly

skills.title: Isaga ayaa iskiisa u dhoola cadeeyo si uu dareenkaaga u soo jiito
skills.sourceTitle: Smiles on his own to get your attention

skills.title: Muusood (wali aan ahayn qosol buuxa) markaad isku daydo inaad ka qosliso
skills.sourceTitle: Chuckles (not yet a full laugh) when you try to make him laugh

skills.title: Wuu ku soo fiiriyaa, dhaqaaqaa, ama wuxuu sameeyaa dhawaaqyo si uu u helo ama u xafido dareenkaaga
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at you, moves, or makes sounds to get or keep your attention

skills.title: Waxay sameeyaan dhawaaqyada sida “oooo”, “aahh” (ganuunicid)
skills.sourceTitle: Makes sounds like “oooo”, “aahh” (cooing)

skills.title: Wuxuu sameeyaa dhawaaq celin markaad la hadasho
skills.sourceTitle: Makes sounds back when you talk to him

skills.title: Wuxuu madaxa uu leexiyaa dhanka codkaaga ka jiro
skills.sourceTitle: Turns head towards the sound of your voice

skills.title: Haddii ay gaajaysan tahay, waxay kala furtaa afka markay aragto naaska ama masaasada
skills.sourceTitle: If hungry, opens mouth when he sees breast or bottle

skills.title: Gacmihiisa ayuu eegaa isagoo xiisaynaya
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at her hands with interest

skills.title: Waxay madaxa xasilisaa iyadoo aan taageero lahayn markaad iyada qabato
skills.sourceTitle: Holds head steady without support when you are holding him

skills.title: Wuxuu qabsadaa alaab-alaabayda markaad gacanta u geliso
skills.sourceTitle: Holds a toy when you put it in his hand

skills.title: Waxay isticmaashaa gacanteeda inay ku lulato alaabta ay ku ciyaarto
skills.sourceTitle: Uses his arm to swing at toys

skills.title: Waxay isku keentaa gacmaha iyo afka
skills.sourceTitle: Brings hands to mouth

skills.title: Wuxuu kor ugu riixaa suxullada/gacmaha hore markuu caloosha ku jiro
skills.sourceTitle: Pushes up onto elbows/forearms when on tummy

skills.title: Wuxuu yaqaanaa dadka caanka ku ah
skills.sourceTitle: Knows familiar people

skills.title: Wuxuu jecel yahay inuu isku eego muraayad
skills.sourceTitle: Likes to look at self in a mirror

skills.title: Wuu Qoslaa
skills.sourceTitle: Laughs

skills.title: Wuxuu qaataa tookadiisa asagoo sameeynaa dhawaaqyo
skills.sourceTitle: Takes turns making sounds with you

skills.title: Afuufaa "raasberi" (carrabka ayuu soo bixiyaa wuuna afuufaa)
skills.sourceTitle: Blows “raspberries” (sticks tongue out and blows)

skills.title: Wuxuu sameeyaa sawaxano cabaad ah
skills.sourceTitle: Makes squealing noises

skills.title: Waxay afka gelisaa waxyaabo si ay u baarto
skills.sourceTitle: Puts things in her mouth to explore them

skills.title: Wuxuu gaara si uu u qabsado alaabta uu rabo
skills.sourceTitle: Reaches to grab a toy she wants

skills.title: Waxay isku xirtaa bishimaha si ay u muujiso in aysan doonayn cunto dheeraad ah
skills.sourceTitle: Closes lips to show she doesn’t want more food

skills.title: Wuxuu isku duubaa caloosha ilaa dhabarka
skills.sourceTitle: Rolls from tummy to back

skills.title: Wuxuu kor iskugu qaadaa gacmo toosan marka uu caloosha u jiifo
skills.sourceTitle: Pushes up with straight arms when on tummy

skills.title: Wuxuu ku tiirsadaa gacmaha si uu isu taageero marka uu fadhiisanaayo
skills.sourceTitle: Leans on hands to support herself when sitting

skills.title: Wuu xishoodaa, kugu dheggaa, ama ka baqayaa agagaarka shisheeyaha
skills.sourceTitle: Is shy, clingy, or fearful around strangers

skills.title: Waxay muujisaa tibaaxo badan oo waji ah, sida farxad, murugo, xanaaq, iyo yaab
skills.sourceTitle: Shows several facial expressions, like happy, sad, angry, and surprised

skills.title: Way ku soo fiirisaa markaad magaceeda ugu wacdo
skills.sourceTitle: Looks when you call her name

skills.title: Waxay falcelisaa markaad baxdo (eeg, ku soo gaarto, ama ooydo)
skills.sourceTitle: Reacts when you leave (looks, reaches for you, or cries)

skills.title: Dhoola cadeeyaa ama qoslaa marka aad ciyaareyso peek- a-boo
skills.sourceTitle: Smiles or laughs when you play peek-a-boo

skills.title: Wuxuu sameeyaa dhawaaqyo kala duwan sida "Hooyohooyo" iyo "aaabeaabe”
skills.sourceTitle: Makes a lot of different sounds like “mamamama” and “bababababa”

skills.title: Gacmaha ayuu kor u qaadaa si loo soo qaado
skills.sourceTitle: Lifts arms up to be picked up

skills.title: Wuxuu raadiyaa shay marka uu ka baxo aragga (sida malqacaddiisa ama alaabtiisa)
skills.sourceTitle: Looks for objects when dropped out of sight (like his spoon or toy)

skills.title: Laba shay ayay isku wada garaacaan
skills.sourceTitle: Bangs two things together

skills.title: Waxay heshaa meel ay fadhiisato kaligeeda
skills.sourceTitle: Gets to a sitting position by herself

skills.title: Waxay u kala badashaa shayga hal gacan ilaa gacanteeda kale
skills.sourceTitle: Moves things from one hand to her other hand

skills.title: Wuxuu isticmaalaa faraha si uu ugu "aruuriyo" cuntada xagiisa
skills.sourceTitle: Uses fingers to “rake” food towards himself

skills.title: Wuxuu fadhiistaa bilaa taageero
skills.sourceTitle: Sits without support

skills.title: Wuxuu kula ciyaaraa ciyaaraha, sida pat-a-cake
skills.sourceTitle: Plays games with you, like pat-a-cake

skills.title: Wuxuu ku gacan haadiyaa "macsalaamo-macsalaamo"
skills.sourceTitle: Waves “bye-bye”

skills.title: Wuxuu ugu yeeraa waalidka "hooyo" ama "aabe" ama magac kale oo gaar ah
skills.sourceTitle: Calls a parent “mama” or “dada” or another special name

skills.title: Wuxuu fahmaya "maya" (si kooban ayuu u hakadaa ama wuu joogsada markaad tiraahdo)
skills.sourceTitle: Understands “no” (pauses briefly or stops when you say it)

skills.title: Wuxuu wax ku ridaa weel, sida bulkeeti yar inuu koob ku rido
skills.sourceTitle: Puts something in a container, like a block in a cup

skills.title: Wuxuu raadiyaa waxyaabo uu ku arko adigoo qarinaya, sida boombalada buste hoostiisa galisay
skills.sourceTitle: Looks for things he sees you hide, like a toy under a blanket

skills.title: Wax ayuu soo jiidaa si uu u istaago
skills.sourceTitle: Pulls up to stand

skills.title: Wuxuu ku socdaa, qabsadaa alaabta guriga
skills.sourceTitle: Walks, holding on to furniture

skills.title: Wuxuu wax ku cabaa koob aan dabool lahayn, markaad u qabato
skills.sourceTitle: Drinks from a cup without a lid, as you hold it

skills.title: Waxay shayaalka ku soo qaadaa suulka iyo farta tilmaanta dhexdooda, sida cuntooyin yaryar ee jabka ah
skills.sourceTitle: Picks things up between thumb and pointer finger, like small bits of food

skills.title: Waxay koobiyeeyaan carruurta kale marka ay ciyaarayaan, sida inay alaabta ay ku ciyaaraan ka soo saaraan weelka marka uu ilmo kale sameeyo
skills.sourceTitle: Copies other children while playing, like taking toys out of a container when another child does

skills.title: Waxay ku tusinayaan shay ay jecel yihiin
skills.sourceTitle: Shows you an object she likes

skills.title: Way sacbiyaan markay farxaan
skills.sourceTitle: Claps when excited

skills.title: Waxay isku duuban boombalada cufan ama qalab kale oo lagu ciyaaro
skills.sourceTitle: Hugs stuffed doll or other toy

skills.title: Wuxuu ku tusaa kalgacayl (wuu ku habsiin, koolkoolin, ama ku dhunkani)
skills.sourceTitle: Shows you affection (hugs, cuddles, or kisses you)

skills.title: Wuxuu isku dayaa inuu yiraahdo hal ama laba kelmadood oo aan ka ahayn "hooyo" ama "aabe," sida "ba" oo ah kubbad ama "da" oo ah eey
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to say one or two words besides “mama” or “dada,” like “ba” for ball or “da” for dog

skills.title: Wuxuu eegaa shay uu yaqaano markaad magacowdo
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at a familiar object when you name it

skills.title: Waxay raacdaa tilmaamaha lagu bixiyo tilmaam iyo kelmado labadaba. Tusaale ahaan, waxa uu ku siinayaa qalab ay ku ciyaaraan marka aad gacanta soo taagto oo aad ku tidhaahdo, "I sii alaabta".
skills.sourceTitle: Follows directions given with both a gesture and words. For example, he gives you a toy when you hold out your hand and say, “Give me the toy.”

skills.title: Wuxuu tilmaamaa si uu u waydiisto shay ama si uu u helo caawimaad
skills.sourceTitle: Points to ask for something or to get help

skills.title: Wuxuu isku dayaa inuu wax u isticmaalo sida saxda ah, sida takalefoon, koobka, ama buuga
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to use things the right way, like a phone, cup, or book

skills.title: Isku dhejiya ugu yaraan laba shay oo yaryar, sida bulkeetiyo
skills.sourceTitle: Stacks at least two small objects, like blocks

skills.title: Dhawr tillaabo ayuu keligiis qaadaa
skills.sourceTitle: Takes a few steps on his own

skills.title: Waxay isticmaashaa faraha si ay nafteeda ugu quudiso xoogaa cunto ah
skills.sourceTitle: Uses fingers to feed herself some food

skills.title: Wuu kaa dheeraadaa, laakiin wuxuu eegayaa inuu hubiyo inaad u dhowdahay
skills.sourceTitle: Moves away from you, but looks to make sure you are close by

skills.title: Wuxuu tilmaamaa si uu kuu tusiyo wax xiiso leh
skills.sourceTitle: Points to show you something interesting

skills.title: Gacmaha ayuu kuu soo saara si aad ugu dhaqdo
skills.sourceTitle: Puts hands out for you to wash them

skills.title: Waxa uu kula eegayaa dhawr bog oo buug ku jira
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at a few pages in a book with you

skills.title: Wuxuu kaa caawinayaa inaad u labisato isaga cudud ku riixaya shaati ama cagta kor u qaadaysa
skills.sourceTitle: Helps you dress him by pushing arm through sleeve or lifting up foot

skills.title: Wuxuu isku dayaa inuu yiraahdo saddex ama in ka badan oo aan ahayn "hooyo" ama "aabe"
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to say three or more words besides “mama” or “dada”

skills.title: Waxay raacdaa tilmaamo hal-tallaabo ah iyada oo aan wax dhaqdhaqaaq ah samayn, sida markay ku siinaysa boombalada marka aad tidhaahdo, "I sii."
skills.sourceTitle: Follows one-step directions without any gestures, like giving you the toy when you say, “Give it to me.”

skills.title: Waxay koobiyaysaa adiga oo qabanaysa shaqooyinka, sida ku xaaqidda xaaqinka
skills.sourceTitle: Copies you doing chores, like sweeping with a broom

skills.title: Wuxuu ku ciyaaraa alaabada ay ku ciyaaraan si fudud, sida riixida gaadhiga caruurtu ku ciyaaraan
skills.sourceTitle: Plays with toys in a simple way, like pushing a toy car

skills.title: Wuxuu socdaa isagoo aan qofna ama waxna qabsan
skills.sourceTitle: Walks without holding on to anyone or anything

skills.title: Qoraa
skills.sourceTitle: Scribbles

skills.title: Waxa uu ka cabaa koob aan dabool lahayn waxaana laga yaabaa inay mararka qaarkood daato
skills.sourceTitle: Drinks from a cup without a lid and may spill sometimes

skills.title: Waxay nafteeda ku quudisaa faraheeda
skills.sourceTitle: Feeds himself with his fingers

skills.title: Wuxuu isku dayaa inuu isticmaalo qaado
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to use a spoon

skills.title: Wuxuu ku fuulaa oo ka soo baxa sariir ama kursi iyada oo aan la caawin
skills.sourceTitle: Climbs on and off a couch or chair without help

skills.title: Wuxuu ogaadaa marka dadka kale ay dhaawacmaan ama xanaaqaan, sida hakinta ama murugada marka qof ooyo
skills.sourceTitle: Notices when others are hurt or upset, like pausing or looking sad when someone is crying

skills.title: Eeg wajigaaga si aad u aragto sida looga falceliyo xaalad cusub
skills.sourceTitle: Looks at your face to see how to react in a new situation

skills.title: Wuxuu tilmaamayaa waxyaabaha ku jira buug marka aad waydiiso, sida "Aaway oorsodu?"
skills.sourceTitle: Points to things in a book when you ask, like “Where is the bear?”

skills.title: Waxay dhahaan ugu yaraan laba kelmadood, sida "caano badan."
skills.sourceTitle: Says at least two words together, like “More milk.”

skills.title: Wuxuu tilmaamayaa ugu yaraan laba xubnood oo jirka ah markaad weydiiso inuu ku tuso
skills.sourceTitle: Points to at least two body parts when you ask him to show you

skills.title: Wuxuu adeegsadaa dhaqdhaqaaqyo ka badan hal-ku- dhegyo ka badan gacan-ku-taaga oo kaliya, sida u afuufida dhunkasho ama u luxida haa
skills.sourceTitle: Uses more gestures than just waving and pointing, like blowing a kiss or nodding yes

skills.title: Waxa uu ku hayaa gacanta hal gacan isagoo isticmaalaya gacanta kale; tusaale ahaan, haynta weel oo furka ka qaad
skills.sourceTitle: Holds something in one hand while using the other hand; for example, holding a container and taking the lid off

skills.title: Waxay isku daydaa in ay isticmaasho furayaasha, handaraafyada, ama badhamada qalabka lagu ciyaaro
skills.sourceTitle: Tries to use switches, knobs, or buttons on a toy

skills.title: Waxa uu ku ciyaaraa in ka badan hal boombale isku mar, sida in cuntada lagu ciyaaro saxanada lagu ciyaaro
skills.sourceTitle: Plays with more than one toy at the same time, like putting toy food on a toy plate

skills.title: Wuxuu laadaa kubad
skills.sourceTitle: Kicks a ball

skills.title: Wuu orda
skills.sourceTitle: Runs

skills.title: Wuxuu ku socdaa (ma amaha fuulitaan) dhawr jaranjaro isagoo haysta ama aan lahayn caawimaad
skills.sourceTitle: Walks (not climbs) up a few stairs with or without help

skills.title: Wuxuu wax ku cunaa qaado
skills.sourceTitle: Eats with a spoon
